head: codex/137-wp04-native-distributed-workflow
title: [v0.92][WP-04.16] Register three-platform distributed native proof workflow
body:
Closes #137

## Summary
- register a dispatch-only WP-04 native proof workflow with a required exact 40-hex source SHA bound to the workflow dispatch commit before checkout
- run the existing #5878 producer on pinned Linux, macOS, and Windows jobs with distinct run-attempt-platform receipts
- aggregate all three fragments on Ubuntu and invoke the existing live GitHub run/job attestation validator
- retain an issue-owned static workflow contract plus repository path-policy proof

## Validation
- issue-owned workflow contract and full repository path-policy suite: passed
- YAML parse and diff hygiene: passed
- independent exact-head review: approved after fixing dispatch-source binding P1
- hosted CI: required before merge

## Scope
Only `.github/workflows/wp04-native-distributed.yml` and issue #137 lifecycle/proof paths; no #5878 producer, validator, manifest, or evidence files changed.
